coreClaim: Remote regenerated-message swipe saves no longer report a false 30-second failure and no longer rewrite large message, swipe, and chat collections in the foreground request.

inScope: Atomic message, message-swipe, and affected chat-memory record upserts

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The add-swipe command commits related record upserts through a short-lived durable marker and record journals, while the remote caller waits for the real result without a finite client deadline.
claimBoundary.riskType: persistent storage and remote runtime contract
entrypoints: storageApi.addChatMessageSwipe in embedded Tauri and remote HTTP runtimes
FileStorage grouped journal recovery during runtime and startup
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing messages with embedded or sidecar swipe representations
positiveRowsTested: Active appended swipe with per-swipe metadata
Partial grouped-transaction application followed by idempotent recovery
negativeRowsTested: Poisoned cache acknowledgement fails before durable commit
Inactive append preserves the current visible swipe
Legacy embedded and noncanonical sidecars retain full cleanup
Primary collection files remain byte-identical during the foreground save
groundTruthFacts: The live Pi completed chat_message_add_swipe in 30016 ms after a 31317 ms LLM stream.
The mobile browser aborted at its 30000 ms finite remote deadline and nginx recorded HTTP 499.
The saved message contains the final 442-character response as swipe index 1 despite the UI failure.
The Pi message and swipe primary collections were approximately 26.6 MB and 27.3 MB.
claimBoundary.userActionCopy: No user action or migration is required.
manualBlockers: Exact target-device latency can only be measured after the merged Pi images are published and deployed.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: A durable server mutation continued after the browser's finite timeout, while the storage owner rewrote complete large collections for one appended swipe.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A durable swipe save returns its real result and performs work proportional to the changed records.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The wrapper opts this command out of the finite client deadline, and storage commits a grouped marker before exposing record-local upserts and removing the marker.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src-tauri owns durable grouped persistence; src/shared/api owns the remote request deadline.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not fake success in React, retry a non-idempotent mutation, or merely increase the global timeout.
regressionProof: Vitest asserts the exact timeoutMs null invocation option.
Rust command proof asserts active content, swipe metadata, memory pruning, unrelated-row preservation, byte-identical primaries, and restart recovery.
Storage proof forces partial transaction recovery and a cache acknowledgement failure.

positiveRows.claim: The remote wrapper waits for the durable swipe result.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm vitest run src/shared/api/storage-api.spec.ts passed with the exact timeoutMs null assertion.

positiveRows.claim: Appending a swipe avoids foreground primary rewrites and survives restart.

contradictionRows.claim: A pre-commit memory cleanup error must not partially save the swipe.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Bunny found that acquiring the cache only after durable commit could save successfully and then return a cache-lock error.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: The grouped path now acquires and holds the cache lock before writing the commit marker, with journaled_upsert_cache_failure_does_not_commit proving no marker or data change on preflight failure.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Bunny found that legacy embedded or noncanonical swipe rows could retain stale sidecars under an upsert-only fast path.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: The fast path now requires canonical deterministic sidecar IDs; legacy rows retain full replacement cleanup and have a focused regression.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Hosted Bunny found machine-local Pi paths in durable rollback evidence.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: Tracked evidence now uses <data-dir>/data/collections and <backup-dir> placeholders while retaining the exact collection and recovery artifact names.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Hosted Bunny found the live chat title in tracked repro evidence.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: The spec and ledger now use sanitized live-chat descriptions while retaining the measured timing, response length, swipe count, and collection sizes.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Hosted Bunny noted that a missing required chat record could still allow related grouped upserts to commit.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: The grouped helper now rejects a missing required record before durable commit, with a restart-level regression proving neither the message nor sidecar changes persist.
